# strings

Extract printable byte sequences from files through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/strings input.bin

moonx cli/strings -n 8 -t x input.bin
```

Read raw file bytes or stdin and print runs meeting the minimum length, optionally with offsets or filenames.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f`, `--print-file-name` | print the file name before each string |
| `-n VALUE`, `--bytes VALUE` | print sequences at least N bytes long Default: `4`. |
| `-t VALUE`, `--radix VALUE` | display offsets in d, o, or x radix Default: `""`. |
| `-e VALUE`, `--encoding VALUE` | s: 7-bit bytes (default); S: 8-bit bytes |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- Supports the documented 7-bit/8-bit byte profiles, including tabs. Wide encodings, Unicode classification and object-file section parsing are unsupported.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
